newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ROTTERDAM BUNKERS GAIN $1, BUYERS KEEP AWAY.
newsitem.headline: ROTTERDAM BUNKERS GAIN $1, BUYERS KEEP AWAY.

text.p: Fuel oil bunker prices in Rotterdam firmed by $1 a tonne again, while those in the rest of Europe were broadly stable, dealers said.
Gas oil prices in most areas increased following the sharp rise in futures on Tuesday.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $98/$100 fob as barges edged up.
Enquiries remained at a low level, no more than 10,000 tonnes by most estimates, as many buyers continued to believe the market was overvalued.
Hamburg prices were steady, also with thin demand.
Mediterranean fuel oil was steady, while gas oil quotes rose by $3/$4 a tonne. Activity in a number of ports calmed after a busy start to the week.
